name: stream-error-partial-kept
description: A stream error in the order Studio's loop makes the calls: finishStream first, then setError. setError only removes a message that is still streaming, and finishStream has already let go of it, so the partial assistant turn (here, a tool call whose arguments were cut off) stays in the transcript and goes out on the next send. Frozen as it is today; the harness plan's J1.4 changes it.
script: Stream error: upstream closed the connection
